criterion: which semantic relation holds between the two entities stated at the end of the text ("The relation between X and Y")

categories.name: Agent-Creation
categories.definition: X is the creator, author, designer, architect, composer, or originator of the work, invention, or entity Y.

categories.name: Agent-Role
categories.definition: X is a person whose profession, role, or group affiliation is described by Y.

categories.name: Part-Whole
categories.definition: X is a component, member, subdivision, or part of the larger entity or group Y.

categories.name: Place-Location
categories.definition: X is a geographic entity, facility, or structure located within or situated in the place Y.

categories.name: Product-Producer
categories.definition: X is a product, work, or release published, manufactured, developed, or distributed by the company, label, or entity Y.

categories.name: Event-Participant
categories.definition: X is an event, competition, or occurrence in which the person, team, or entity Y participated or was involved.

categories.name: Event-Time
categories.definition: X is a specific time or year associated with the occurrence of the event Y.

categories.name: Geographic-Feature
categories.definition: X is a body of water, mountain, or landform that flows into, is a tributary of, or is part of the geographic feature Y.

categories.name: Administrative-Division
categories.definition: X is a city, state, province, or region located within or belonging to the larger administrative area Y.

categories.name: Taxonomic-Classification
categories.definition: X is a biological taxon (e.g., species, genus) classified within the higher taxonomic rank or group Y.

categories.name: Family-Relation
categories.definition: X is a person related by blood, marriage, or lineage to the person Y.

categories.name: Succession
categories.definition: X is an entity that precedes, succeeds, or replaces Y in a sequence, series, or order.

categories.name: Award-Nomination
categories.definition: X is a work, person, or entity nominated for or winning the award or honor Y.

categories.name: Content-Platform
categories.definition: X is a game, software, show, or content released on or broadcast by the platform, console, or network Y.

categories.name: Organization-Location
categories.definition: X is an organization, team, or institution based in, headquartered in, or representing the location Y.

categories.name: Adaptation-Source
categories.definition: X is a work (book, play, etc.) adapted into or serving as the source material for the work Y.

categories.name: Character-Creator
categories.definition: X is a fictional character created by or featured in the work by the author or artist Y.

categories.name: Name-Origin
categories.definition: X is a name, word, or title derived from, inspired by, or a translation of the name or entity Y.

categories.name: Object-User
categories.definition: X is an object, weapon, vehicle, or instrument used by or associated with the person or entity Y.

categories.name: Concept-Field
categories.definition: X is a concept, term, or subject defined by or belonging to the field of study or category Y.

categories.name: Entity-Affiliation
categories.definition: X is a person or entity affiliated with, employed by, or allied with the organization, group, or entity Y.
